title_zh: 三座换轨场空间图谱合同
title_en: Three Civic Switchyards Spatial Atlas Contract
purpose_zh: 把既有三处重点区的普通任务、旁侧验证、停止对象、人工交接和恢复对象放入同一可比较读图，不新增空间事实或服务承诺。
purpose_en: Place the existing ordinary task, side proof layer, stop object, staffed handoff and recovery object of all three key areas into one comparable reading without adding spatial facts or service commitments.

prototypes.ordinary_spatial_relation_zh: 普通绕行在下，验证庭在旁且不相交。
prototypes.ordinary_spatial_relation_en: The ordinary bypass stays below while the proof court remains beside it and never intersects it.
prototypes.proof_stop_object_zh: 庭内旁侧验证与设备边
prototypes.proof_stop_object_en: The side proof court and equipment edge
prototypes.staffed_handoff_zh: 绕行与庭边之间的人工维护交接
prototypes.staffed_handoff_en: Staffed maintenance handoff between the bypass and court edge
prototypes.recovery_object_zh: 庭内锚地与周边环境；先回到普通绕行
prototypes.recovery_object_en: The court anchor and surrounding environment; return to the ordinary bypass first

prototypes.name_zh: 北京 AI 原点社区
prototypes.ordinary_spatial_relation_zh: 一街连接两院，四个节点均可逐点撤回。
prototypes.ordinary_spatial_relation_en: One street connects two courts while four nodes can be withdrawn one by one.
prototypes.proof_stop_object_zh: 两院旁置验证、屏幕、采集与临时标识
prototypes.proof_stop_object_en: Side proof, screens, collection and temporary markers at the two courts
prototypes.staffed_handoff_zh: 街外纸质或口述人工交接
prototypes.staffed_handoff_en: Paper or spoken staffed handoff outside the street
prototypes.recovery_object_zh: 两院日常与居民街；先回到居民日常和安静通行
prototypes.recovery_object_en: The two courts' ordinary use and resident street; return to resident life and quiet passage first

prototypes.ordinary_spatial_relation_zh: 四向通勤十字保持连续，发布厅和人工台退出路外。
prototypes.ordinary_spatial_relation_en: The four-way commuter cross remains continuous while the publication hall and staffed desk sit off-route.
prototypes.proof_stop_object_zh: 路外发布支线、来源审查与临时屏幕
prototypes.proof_stop_object_en: The off-route publication side line, source review and temporary screens
prototypes.staffed_handoff_zh: 双入口人工台与路外安静休息
prototypes.staffed_handoff_en: The two-entry staffed desk and off-route quiet rest
prototypes.recovery_object_zh: 路外发布厅与来源记录；先回到四向通勤和人工服务
prototypes.recovery_object_en: The off-route hall and source record; return to four-way commuting and staffed service first

evidence_limits.zh: 图谱只表达 G0 概念关系，不证明现状建筑、精确位置、尺寸、材料、连接、无障碍结果、消防或铁路结论、人员、排班、批准、恢复时长或现实结果。
evidence_limits.en: The atlas expresses G0 conceptual relations only. It proves no existing building, precise location, dimension, material, connection, accessibility result, fire or railway conclusion, staffing, roster, approval, recovery duration, or real-world outcome.
